SELECT s.signup_id, s.activity_id, s.user_id, s.signup_time, s.status, a.title AS activityTitle, a.location AS activityLocation, a.start_time AS activityStartTime,
-- 🔥 核心修改：查出结束时间并对应 Java 属性名 a.end_time AS activityEndTime,
a.cover_image AS activityCover, a.status AS activityStatus, a.max_people AS maxPeople, a.current_people AS currentPeople FROM activity_signup s LEFT JOIN activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY s.signup_time DESC
